unit.why: A legend about the death of Nachmanides (Ramban), a pre-Hasidic sage, taken from an old pamphlet.

stories.start_quote: פטירת הרמב״ן ז״ל. מובא בקונטרס ישן
stories.summary_en: Before leaving for the Land of Israel, Nachmanides tells his disciples that his mother's tombstone will crack, showing a menorah figure, on the day of his death; three years later a disciple finds it so, and the community mourns him.

tags.why: Praises the Ramban, a pre-Hasidic sage; copied from an old pamphlet
The story is about the Ramban's death and the sign that announced it

quotes: בזאת תדעון כי ביום פטירתי תבקע מצבת הורתי
tags.why: He foretells the sign of his death, and it comes true
The story's arc is a prediction that is fulfilled

quotes: מצא תלמיד אחד את המצבה נבקעת והמנורה מצויירת בה
tags.why: The tombstone miraculously cracks and shows a menorah

quotes: בחר ללכת לארץ ישראל למות שם
tags.why: He travels to the Land of Israel to die there

quotes: ויתאבלו מאד ויבכו אותו כל ישראל
tags.why: His death and the mourning for it

quotes: והיו תלמידיו מלויין אותו ובקשו ממנו
tags.why: Master and disciples, though not Hasidic

quotes: ונשמע ח״כ שנקבר הרב על דרך ביאת גאולים
tags.why: His burial place is presented as significant

quotes: על דרך ביאת גאולים שיהי׳ לעתיד לבא
tags.why: He is buried on the road of the future redemption

quotes: תבקע מצבת הורתי הנקברת בעיר הזאת
tags.why: His mother is mentioned only through her tombstone
His mother's grave plays a role, though she is not a character

missing_concepts: sign or token agreed in advance to announce a death at a distance
